# Aaryan Singh — whiteye.in

> Software engineer based in Assam, India, working remotely. Founding engineer at ReferRush (Feb 2025 – Sep 2026) and an early engineer at Extraordinary. Now builds consumer products at scale and is on trial with LinkMe, the creator platform for consumers and businesses. Previously built instantKV, a memory store for AI agents in Rust, and Morse, an agent runtime. 47 pull requests merged across 13 external open-source repositories. Left the University of Waterloo to build full time.

Everything here is public and readable without an account or JavaScript. Benchmark numbers describe specific hardware, workloads and transports; each page links its measurement conditions.

## Software
- [instantKV](https://instantkv.com): Local-first agent memory in Rust; bounded BM25 search, topic/tag/time filters, revisioned writes and native OpenCode MCP. Source: https://github.com/maskjelly/instantKV
- [instantKV benchmarks](https://instantkv.com/benchmarks/): LongMemEval-S 95.13% Recall@10 (500 questions, 14.34 MiB sampled server RAM, M4 Pro); LoCoMo, BEIR SciFact, ArguAna and NFCorpus; raw reports and limits.
- [Morse](https://github.com/maskjelly/morse): Rust agent runtime with remote execution that survives client disconnects, streamed tool output, session replay and crash recovery.
- [rushort](https://github.com/maskjelly/rushort): Raw HTTP/1.1 URL shortener in Rust with SQLite WAL durability. 1.34M redirects/s on a four-vCPU VPS (loopback, pipeline depth 512). [Live telemetry](https://whiteye.in/telemetry) includes synthetic traffic.
- [TiVM](https://github.com/maskjelly/TiVM): Computer-use testing in a Linux desktop with accessibility, screenshots, video and reports.
- [FireScope](https://github.com/maskjelly/firescope): Typed Firebase SDK and CLI.
- [Rove](https://github.com/maskjelly/rove): Terminal AI assistant with streamed output and a live observer feed.
- [Plain Corners](https://whiteye.in/plain-corners): Native macOS utility for subtler window corners.
- [comuse](https://github.com/maskjelly/comuse): Computer-use tooling connected to agent harnesses through MCP.
